gloss: celebratory meal; festive tray of dishes

definitions.gloss: celebratory meal; festive tray of dishes
definitions.explanation: A special set of dishes served to mark an occasion such as a birth, a wedding, a milestone birthday, or New Year. {膳|ぜん} is the individual tray on which a formal Japanese meal is laid out, so the word names both the food and its presentation.

examples.japanese: {祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め→お食い初め：24466_okuizome⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: We laid out a celebratory meal for the baby's first-food ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I told her the wedding was settled, my grandmother had a celebratory meal waiting for me.

examples.japanese: {祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧や⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧、⟦めでたい→めでたい：17687_medetai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: A celebratory meal features auspicious dishes such as sea bream and red rice.

notes:
Belongs to the vocabulary of family ceremonies rather than restaurants, and is usually something prepared or ordered at home for an occasion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare a celebratory meal
- {祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to gather around a celebratory meal
- ⟦お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め→お食い初め：24466_okuizome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祝|いわ}い{膳|ぜん}: the meal for a baby's first-food ceremony

CULTURAL NOTE:
The dishes are chosen for their auspicious associations: ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧ (sea bream) for ⟦めでたい→めでたい：17687_medetai⟧, ⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧ (red rice) for celebration, and whole fish or foods served in pairs for completeness.
